rules.name: Epic Games Launcher web cache
rules.why: The Epic launcher's embedded-browser cache. Your games, saves and library are never touched.
sources: Epic Games Launcher stores its CEF web cache under %LOCALAPPDATA%\EpicGamesLauncher\Saved\webcache*.

rules.name: Battle.net cache
rules.why: The Battle.net client's web cache. Your games and account are never touched.
sources: Battle.net stores its browser cache under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Battle.net\Cache and %ProgramData%\Battle.net\Cache; Blizzard support recommends clearing it.

rules.name: Ubisoft Connect cache
rules.why: Ubisoft Connect's cache. Your games, saves and account are never touched.
sources: Ubisoft Connect stores its cache under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Ubisoft Game Launcher\cache; Ubisoft support recommends clearing it.

rules.name: EA app cache
rules.why: The EA app's embedded-browser cache. Your games, saves and account are never touched.
sources: The EA app (EA Desktop) stores its CEF browser cache under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Electronic Arts\EA Desktop\CEF.

rules.name: GOG Galaxy web cache
rules.why: GOG Galaxy's embedded-browser cache. Your games, saves and account are never touched.
sources: GOG Galaxy stores its web cache under %ProgramData%\GOG.com\Galaxy\webcache.
